name: efs-platform
description: EFS Learning Academy — interactive equipment and maintenance practice

scripts.check: node --check build.mjs && node --check server.mjs && node -e "const {readdirSync}=require('fs'),{execFileSync}=require('child_process');for(const f of readdirSync('src',{recursive:true}).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')))execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check','src/'+f],{stdio:'inherit'})"
